title: ComplianceControlsResponse
description: Wire response returned by GET /v1-compliance-controls. Resolves the compliance control catalog into live enforcement status per regulatory clause. Read-only; requires the `compliance:read` scope. Optional `framework`, `from`, and `to` query params narrow the window and framework.

framework.description: Framework code the catalog was filtered to (e.g. 'cfr_part_11', 'eu_annex_11'). null when no `framework` query param was supplied — all frameworks are returned.

window.description: Resolved evaluation window the live status aggregates were computed over.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the server resolved the catalog status.

summary.description: Roll-up of control statuses across the returned set.

controls.description: One row per regulatory clause in the (optionally filtered) catalog, resolved to a live enforcement status.

metric.description: Raw aggregate the status was derived from. Shape is status_query-specific; treat as opaque.

truncated.description: true when the catalog set was capped server-side and not every matching control is included.
